pages.text: [#](53341a)Greater strength brings stone-breaking power and a second appeal to Lilith.[#]() [#](53341a)A red flower and another filled goblet open the path to higher mastery.[#]() [#](53341a)Flight follows; distance and village walls matter less than before.[#]()
pages.title: Mastery Over Blood

pages.text: [#](53341a)Transfixed victims can be guided into cages for careful feeding.[#]() [#](53341a)Power over blood becomes power over making new vampires.[#]() [#](53341a)The final note describes a coffin, a goblet, and an unwilling rebirth.[#]()
